content.value: A continuous and aligned glass fiber reinforced composite consists of 35 vol. % glass fiber and balance of polyester resin. The modulus of elasticity and tensile strength of the fiber and matrix are given below:
Assuming that the stress is applied parallel to the direction of fiber aligned and the matrix stress at composite failure is 10 MPa.
(i) Compute modulus of elasticity of the composite.
(ii) Compute the tensile strength of the composite.
